_about: Sound cues for fw-mix.mjs (draft 2). A cue names a stem by id (resolved in out/legend-fisher/{music|sfx}/manifest.json, else the first out/legend-fisher/<dir>/<id>*.wav) or a direct repo path in file. at / to: seconds, or an anchor 'L15:black' (line id : word start), 'L15' (line start), 'END', each with an optional +/-offset. gain is linear. loop repeats between at and to; trim = seconds of the file to use; fi/fo fades; take = which take of the id (default 0; the take used is noted in 'take'). duck: true puts the cue on the bus that is lowered 7 dB under every voice line (music always; wind and surf also). A missing file is skipped with a warning. Music plan after Sol's answer (sol-music/answer-summary.md); take non-alt = out/legend-fisher/music/<id>.wav (the picker's choice, not the -alt file); a numeric take = files[take] of the id in sfx/manifest.json (0 = the picker's first file, -01.wav); music longer than its 10 s take is looped with a 0.5 s crossfade: hard silences at frame 0 to 0.20 s, 0.5 s on 'black', a hard mute at the vanishing, nothing after the kid's last question.
